title: Universal quantifier
summary: Universal quantification requires a statement to hold for every permitted value in a domain.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared predicate logic context is fixed.

content.plain: Universal quantification requires a statement to hold for every permitted value in a domain.
content.exact: Given formula φ(x), ∀x φ(x) is satisfied in M when φ holds under every assignment of a domain element to x.
content.caveat: The domain and variable range must be recoverable.
